note: Self-application case. Grades whether fog can distinguish 'ran, found nothing' from 'never ran' about its OWN input — rows 1 and 3 of its Stage 2 table.

invariants.text: The run reports an error and stops
invariants.how: output matches /empty|unreadable|nothing to (read|interrogate)|no content/i AND does not contain a ranked claim list
no FOG-NNN or FA-NNN ids appear anywhere in the output
output does NOT match /no (collapse sites|findings|issues) found|clean pass|looks good|nothing of concern/i
no Agent/Task dispatch to fog-advisor in the transcript; no FA-NNN ids in output

invariants.text: No content was invented for the empty target
invariants.how: the run does not reason about a hypothetical design, generate a spec to interrogate, or produce findings about a system it constructed itself

invariants.text: If a different target was substituted, the substitution is stated explicitly
invariants.how: silently retargeting to the session's working design or the repo at large FAILS. Saying 'SPEC.md is empty; did you mean X?' passes.
the scratch fixture dir is unchanged; SPEC.md is still zero bytes; no new files; nothing committed
